---
title: Convert continuous aggregates to the columnstore
description: Compress a continuous aggregate to the columnstore to save storage space while making sure the data is still available for your analytical workloads
products: [cloud, self_hosted]
keywords: [continuous aggregates, compression]
---

import * as C from "@constants";
import { NumberedList, NumberedItem } from "@components/NumberedList";
import SinceRelease from "@components/SinceRelease.astro";
import DoWithAi from "@components/DoWithAi.astro";
import TestPlan from "@components/TestPlan.astro";

<SinceRelease version="2.20.0" product="tsdb" />

To save on storage costs, you use {C.HYPERCORE} to downsample historical data stored in {C.CAGG}s. After you
[enable {C.HYPERCORE}](/reference/timescaledb/continuous-aggregates/alter_materialized_view) on a `MATERIALIZED VIEW`, you set a
[{C.COLUMNSTORE} policy](/reference/timescaledb/hypercore/add_columnstore_policy). This policy defines the intervals when {C.TIMESCALE_DB} converts {C.CHUNK}s in a {C.CAGG} from the {C.ROWSTORE} to the {C.COLUMNSTORE}.

{C.COLUMNSTORE_CAP} works in the same way on [{C.HYPERTABLE}s and {C.CAGG}s](/learn/columnar-storage/understand-hypercore). When you enable
{C.COLUMNSTORE} with no other options, your data is [ordered by](/reference/timescaledb/continuous-aggregates/alter_materialized_view#arguments) the `time_bucket` column
followed by the remaining `GROUP BY` columns of the {C.CAGG}, and is not [segmented](/reference/timescaledb/continuous-aggregates/alter_materialized_view#arguments).
Before {C.TIMESCALE_DB} v2.25.0, the default was to segment by the `GROUP BY` columns and order by the `time_bucket` column. [{C.RTAGG_CAP}](/learn/continuous-aggregates/real-time-aggregates)
is disabled by default.

<DoWithAi />

## Configure {C.COLUMNSTORE} on {C.CAGG}s

For an [existing {C.CAGG}](/build/continuous-aggregates/create-a-continuous-aggregate):

<NumberedList>
<NumberedItem title={`Enable ${C.HYPERCORE} on a ${C.CAGG}`}>
Set `timescaledb.enable_columnstore = true` when you alter the view:

```sql
ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW <cagg_name> set (timescaledb.enable_columnstore = true);
```

To disable {C.HYPERCORE}, set `timescaledb.enable_columnstore = false`.
</NumberedItem>

<NumberedItem title={`Set the ${C.COLUMNSTORE} policy on the ${C.CAGG}`}>
Before you set up a {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy on a {C.CAGG}, you first set the [refresh policy](/build/continuous-aggregates/refresh-policies). To
prevent refresh policies from failing, set the {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy interval so that {C.TIMESCALE_DB} does not convert
actively refreshed regions to the {C.COLUMNSTORE}. For example:

1. Set the refresh policy:

   ```sql
   SELECT add_continuous_aggregate_policy('<cagg_name>',
     start_offset => INTERVAL '30 days',
     end_offset => INTERVAL '1 day',
     schedule_interval => INTERVAL '1 hour');
   ```

1. Set the {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy. The `after` parameter should be greater than the value of
   `start_offset` in the refresh policy:

   ```sql
   CALL add_columnstore_policy('<cagg_name>', after => INTERVAL '45 days');
   ```
</NumberedItem>
</NumberedList>

## Convert refreshed {C.CHUNK}s to the {C.COLUMNSTORE} during refresh

<SinceRelease version="2.27.0" product="tsdb" />

As an alternative to a separate {C.COLUMNSTORE} policy, you can configure the refresh policy itself to move {C.CAGG} {C.CHUNK}s into the {C.COLUMNSTORE} after each refresh. Use this when you want refreshed data to land in the {C.COLUMNSTORE} on the same schedule as the refresh, with no gap between the two windows.

When you enable `compress_after_refresh` on the refresh policy job, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} converts the {C.CAGG} {C.CHUNK}s in the refresh window to the {C.COLUMNSTORE} at the end of each scheduled refresh. {C.TIMESCALE_DB} processes each {C.CHUNK} in its own transaction, so the job resumes from the last completed {C.CHUNK} if interrupted.

`compress_after_refresh` is a JSONB key on the refresh policy job's `config` and defaults to `false`. Set it with [`alter_job`](/reference/timescaledb/jobs-automation/alter_job):

```sql
SELECT alter_job(<job_id>,
    config => jsonb_set(
        (SELECT config FROM _timescaledb_catalog.bgw_job WHERE id = <job_id>),
        '{compress_after_refresh}', 'true'));
```

You must enable {C.HYPERCORE} on the {C.CAGG} first. Otherwise, {C.TIMESCALE_DB} skips the conversion.

<TestPlan>
target: cloud, self-hosted

1. fork the service
2. [cloud] select the service
3. [self-hosted] run SQL: `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb;`
4. run SQL: `CREATE TABLE conditions (time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, device INTEGER NOT NULL, temperature DOUBLE PRECISION) WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.partition_column = 'time', tsdb.chunk_interval = '1 day');`
5. run SQL: `INSERT INTO conditions SELECT t, d, d * 10 + extract(hour FROM t) FROM generate_series(now() - INTERVAL '90 days', now(), INTERVAL '6 hours') AS t, generate_series(1, 2) AS d;`
6. run SQL: `CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW conditions_summary_daily WITH (timescaledb.continuous) AS SELECT device, time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', time) AS bucket, avg(temperature) FROM conditions GROUP BY device, bucket;`
7. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates WHERE view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND NOT compression_enabled`
8. run SQL: `ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW conditions_summary_daily set (timescaledb.enable_columnstore = true);`
9. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates WHERE view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND compression_enabled AND materialized_only`
10. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.hypertable_columnstore_settings s JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates c ON s.hypertable = format('%I.%I', c.materialization_hypertable_schema, c.materialization_hypertable_name)::regclass WHERE c.view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND coalesce(s.segmentby, '') = '' AND s.orderby = 'bucket,device'`
11. run SQL: `ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW conditions_summary_daily set (timescaledb.enable_columnstore = false);`
12. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates WHERE view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND NOT compression_enabled`
13. run SQL: `ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW conditions_summary_daily set (timescaledb.enable_columnstore = true);`
14. run SQL: `SELECT add_continuous_aggregate_policy('conditions_summary_daily', start_offset => INTERVAL '30 days', end_offset => INTERVAL '1 day', schedule_interval => INTERVAL '1 hour');`
15. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE proc_name = 'policy_refresh_continuous_aggregate' AND hypertable_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND (config->>'start_offset')::interval = INTERVAL '30 days' AND (config->>'end_offset')::interval = INTERVAL '1 day' AND schedule_interval = INTERVAL '1 hour'`
16. run SQL: `CALL add_columnstore_policy('conditions_summary_daily', after => INTERVAL '45 days');`
17. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE proc_name = 'policy_compression' AND hypertable_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND (config->>'compress_after')::interval = INTERVAL '45 days'`
18. run SQL: `CREATE FUNCTION columnstore_job_id() RETURNS int AS $$ SELECT job_id FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE proc_name = 'policy_compression' AND hypertable_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' $$ LANGUAGE sql;`
19. run SQL: `CREATE FUNCTION refresh_job_id() RETURNS int AS $$ SELECT job_id FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE proc_name = 'policy_refresh_continuous_aggregate' AND hypertable_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' $$ LANGUAGE sql;`
20. run SQL: `CALL run_job(columnstore_job_id());`
21. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks ch JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates c ON ch.hypertable_name = c.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE c.view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND ch.is_compressed AND ch.range_end < now() - INTERVAL '45 days'`
22. expect no rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks ch JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates c ON ch.hypertable_name = c.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE c.view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND ch.is_compressed AND ch.range_end > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'`
23. run SQL: `SELECT alter_job(refresh_job_id(), config => jsonb_set((SELECT config FROM _timescaledb_catalog.bgw_job WHERE id = refresh_job_id()), '{compress_after_refresh}', 'true'));`
24. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE job_id = refresh_job_id() AND (config->>'compress_after_refresh')::boolean`
25. run SQL: `INSERT INTO conditions SELECT t, 3, 30 FROM generate_series(now() - INTERVAL '20 days', now() - INTERVAL '2 days', INTERVAL '6 hours') AS t;`
26. run SQL: `CALL run_job(refresh_job_id());`
27. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM conditions_summary_daily WHERE device = 3 LIMIT 1`
28. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks ch JOIN timescaledb_information.continuous_aggregates c ON ch.hypertable_name = c.materialization_hypertable_name WHERE c.view_name = 'conditions_summary_daily' AND ch.is_compressed AND ch.range_end > now() - INTERVAL '30 days'`
</TestPlan>
